real_client_repair.topology: One full survival Forge client without operator privileges, dedicated server, original Retrofit/AR/LibVulpes profile.
real_client_repair.preparations: The fixture provided the original pad, the small sample hull, power and propellant. It removed the original guidance computer and supplied one copy as an inventory item.
real_client_repair.graphical_path: The pilot clicked Scan. The genuine native machine reported NOGUIDANCE. Show part jumped to the example third deck and outlined the original guidance computer in amber. The client returned to the world, placed the supplied native computer using normal survival interaction, reopened the assembler and clicked Scan. The server observed both the original rejection and successful rescan with the item consumed, then native fueled ascent and the same fixed cabin with cargo.
